> [!CAUTION]
> **DO NOT SUBMIT PUBLIC ISSUES FOR POTENTIAL SECURITY VULNERABILITIES!**
> Public disclosure puts all users and deployments at risk.

Please refer to our [Security Policy](https://github.com/Abhiram-C-Divakaran/Ava-AI/blob/main/SECURITY.md) to report security concerns privately through GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting or via maintainer contact.

Thank you for practicing responsible disclosure.
